method solve(n: int, m: int) returns (min_pairs: int, max_pairs: int)
  requires ValidInput(n, m)
  ensures min_pairs >= 0
  ensures max_pairs >= 0
  ensures min_pairs <= max_pairs
  ensures min_pairs == MinFriendshipPairs(n, m)
  ensures max_pairs == MaxFriendshipPairs(n, m)
    ensures false
